nodes.description: Public token name string state variable set in the constructor.
Public token symbol string state variable set in the constructor.
Public uint8 decimals state variable (18).
Total token supply, set to 21000000000000000000000000 in the constructor.
Mapping(address => uint) of token balances; mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested allowance mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)); written by approve and transferFrom.
Constructor: assigns name, symbol, decimals, _totalSupply and mints the whole supply to msg.sender.
Returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] using unchecked subtraction.
Returns balances[tokenOwner] for the given address.
Returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Debits balances[msg.sender] via safeSub and credits balances[to] via safeAdd, then emits Transfer.
Debits balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender] via safeSub, credits balances[to] via safeAdd, emits Transfer.
Adds a and b and requires c >= a to guard against overflow.
Requires b <= a then computes c = a - b.
Computes c = a * b and requires a == 0 || c / a == b.
Requires b > 0 then computes c = a / b.
Caller-controlled address used as minter, balance owner and spender key.
Unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in totalSupply() can underflow.
balances[msg.sender] = safeSub(balances[msg.sender], tokens): user-controlled amount subtracted from balance.
allowed[from][msg.sender] = safeSub(allowed[from][msg.sender], tokens): allowance mutated only after balance debit, arithmetic-critical path.
Raw addition a + b inside safeAdd with only a post-hoc require(c >= a) check.
Raw subtraction a - b inside safeSub guarded by require(b <= a).
Raw multiplication a * b inside safeMul with overflow check require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
Raw division a / b inside safeDiv guarded by require(b > 0).

edges.reason: msg.sender receives the entire initial supply in the constructor.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender], keyed by caller.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] and emits Transfer from msg.sender.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender whose allowance is decremented.
msg.sender indexes the balances mapping in constructor, transfer and transferFrom.
msg.sender indexes the allowed allowance mapping in approve and transferFrom.
Constructor assigns name = 'Kingdom Coin'.
Constructor assigns symbol = 'KING'.
Constructor assigns decimals = 18.
Constructor assigns _totalSupply = 21000000000000000000000000.
Constructor mints the total supply into balances[msg.sender].
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] during subtraction.
totalSupply performs the unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)].
balanceOf reads balances[tokenOwner].
allowance reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping.
transfer decrements the sender balance with safeSub on a user-supplied amount.
transfer credits the recipient via safeAdd, reaching the raw addition.
transfer calls safeAdd.
transfer calls safeSub.
transferFrom reads and writes balances[from] and balances[to].
transferFrom reads and writes allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom decrements the allowance with safeSub after the balance debit.
transferFrom calls safeAdd.
transferFrom calls safeSub twice.
safeAdd body performs the raw addition a + b.
safeSub body performs the raw subtraction a - b.
safeMul body performs the raw multiplication a * b.
safeDiv body performs the raw division a / b.
